title: What Does Best-In-Class Voice AI Design Sound Like?
summary: Great voice-only AI experiences need to reflect how humans actually talk. This quality checklist can help you with your voice AI design.
body_markdown:
Denise Martinez


Lead Conversation Designer


I’m a conversation designer based in the Netherlands, crafting generative AI and conversational AI products and features at Salesforce. My background in education and applied linguistics has helped me tackle real-world language problems and bridge the gap between humans and AI systems.


[More by Denise](https://www.salesforce.com/blog/author/denise-martinez/)


Philipp Hänggi


Senior Agentic Experience Specialist, FDE


Linguistics is where I started. I did a Ph.D. in conversation analysis, which is the empirical study of talk and social interaction. Think about all the subtle things we do when we talk and engage in conversation — how we take turns, repair misunderstandings, or adjust our language based on ...


Read More context. I then decided the theoretical armchair wasn't for me, and I wanted to apply some of those principles to actual products. I moved into industry first as a Language Engineer at Apple, and most recently I was at UBS, leading conversational UX for the bank's multilingual GenAI assistant. The work was essentially helping them migrate from legacy, deterministic chatbot and automated phone systems to LLM-powered conversational interfaces. Anyone working in this space knows that migration is nontrivial, and the lessons from that project shape how I think about agent design now.


[More by Philipp](https://www.salesforce.com/blog/author/philipp-hanggi/)


Tracy Gravelle


Lead UX Conversation Designer


My path into this field started almost by accident. As a Linguistics grad student writing my Master's thesis on syntactic theory, I took a part-time job building speech recognition grammars for telecommunication IVRs. That work drew me into the human factors side of technology — the study of how ...


Read More people and machines actually interact — and I never looked back. After that, I worked as an IVR design consultant for many years — auditing, designing, and building voice applications across different industries. I also helped shape the Alexa experience at Amazon for a few years, and today I'm at Salesforce, designing engaging conversational experiences for Agentforce Voice.


[More by Tracy](https://www.salesforce.com/blog/author/tracy-gravelle/)
